A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]]'''<ref name="TSL" /> was [[Akkere]]'s brother, living on [[Telos IV]] in [[3951 BBY]]. His second [[Akkere's brother's wife|wife]] fell ill and was pregnant but he couldn't afford the Telos [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]]. He asked Akkere to bring him some credits.<ref name="TSL" />
